other.remelting: flipped and remelted at least six times

evidence.quote: The equiatomic ternary VNbTa alloy ingots were fabricated from high-purity V, Nb, and Ta raw metals (99.95 wt%) by non-consumable vacuum arc melting under an high-purity Ar atmosphere (99.95 %). All the alloy ingots were flipped and remelted at least six times to improve the uniformity of composition distribution in alloy.
The ingots were rolled into sheets at RT with a thickness reduction of > 80 % using a precise rolling mill (JH-RZH-110, China).
The cut-off samples were sealed in a vacuum quartz tube with 2.5 × 10^-5 torr, then annealed at 1200 °C for 3 h and followed by water quenching.
